annotations.text: Clean Clarity — spacious sidebar SaaS, indigo accent, professional and trustworthy. Recommended default.
Namaste Warm — top-nav only, Nepali flag-inspired crimson/blue, rounded, big touch targets, Devanagari-ready type. Friendlier for less tech-savvy teachers.
Command Center — dense roster table, compact icon rail, everything visible at once. Best for power users managing many students fast.
